title: What's free, and when do I need to pay?
seoTitle: augo Pricing: Free Tier and Paid Plan | augo support
description: augo is free for up to 2 athletes, permanently. Coaching 3 or more requires the Unlimited plan.
summary: Coaching up to 2 athletes is free permanently — not a trial. From 3 athletes you need the Unlimited plan, which is billed monthly or annually and can be cancelled any time. Athletes never pay.

body.html: augo is free for up to 2 athletes, permanently. That is a real free tier, not a countdown — you can coach two athletes on augo indefinitely without entering a card.

When you need to pay

At 3 athletes or more you need the Unlimited plan. It adds unlimited athletes, unlimited use of the assistant, access to the matching platform and the coach community, and priority support.

Current prices are on the pricing page, which shows the right currency for where you are. Annual billing saves 15%.

Cancelling and changing plans

Upgrade, downgrade or cancel whenever you want. There are no long contracts, no hidden fees and no cancellation charge.

Your data stays yours. You can export it in full at any time and take it with you.

What athletes pay

Nothing, ever. augo is billed to the coach. There is no athlete subscription and no per-athlete surcharge on top of the plan.

faqs.question: Is the free plan a trial?
faqs.answer: No. Up to 2 athletes is free permanently. There is no countdown and no card required.

faqs.question: Can I cancel any time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade or cancel whenever you want, with no long contract and no cancellation fee. You can export all your data on the way out.

faqs.question: Do my athletes need to pay?
faqs.answer: No. augo is billed to the coach. Athletes use it free.

faqs.question: Is there a discount for annual billing?
faqs.answer: Yes, annual billing saves 15% against paying monthly.
